venue.name: King's Theatre
venue.description: A grand Edwardian theatre on Bath Street, the King’s is Glasgow’s home for touring West End musicals, big comedy names, and large-scale drama. With over 1,700 seats across stalls and three balconies, it’s where Glasgow goes for a big night out — and it hosts the city’s legendary annual pantomime every Christmas.

concessions.summary: An ATG house. Concessions are set per production rather than by the venue, so the booking page is the only place they appear; two memberships run across every ATG theatre.

schemes.name: Access Membership Scheme
schemes.eligibility: Free, and open to all Deaf and disabled customers and people with long-term health conditions. Unlocks accessible seats online, any Access concessions on a show, and personal assistant tickets.

schemes.name: ATG+
schemes.eligibility: A paid membership: no booking fees on most ATG shows, priority booking and member discounts across 35+ venues.

concessions.fees: Booking fees apply and vary by show; ATG+ members pay none.
